description: Temporary change of use of the park for a series of special event film screenings between 15th July 2020 and 16th August 2020. Erection of associated temporary structures.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The event is permitted between 22nd June 2020 - 23rd August 2020 inclusive of site construction and demolition.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Transport Assessment (BD&S), Transport Assessment (Venue Operations), Audience Dispersal Plan, Review of Audience Arrangements (Safety), Operational Timings, Community Programme, Gunnersbury Park Council Letter, Landowner Letters, Testimonials, Indicative Audience Dispersal Plan, Ancillary Equipment, Review of Audience Arrangements, Operational Timings, Environmental Statement, Draft Noise Management Protocol, Access Statement, Draft Noise Management Plan, Design/Access Statement, Flood Risk Map, Cover Letter, Documents/Plans Schedule and Drawings P-SC-GP-20-001(V02), P-SC-GP-20-002 (V02), P-SC-GP-20-003(V02), P-SC-GP-20-004(V02), P-SC-GP-20-005 (V02), P-SC-GP-20-006(V02), P-SC-GP-20-007(V02), P-SC-GP-20-008 (V02), P-SC-GP-20-009(V02), P-SC-GP-20-010(V02), P-SC-GP-20-011 (V02), P-SC-GP-20-012(V02), P-SC-GP-20-013(V02), P-SC-GP-20-014 (V02), P-SC-GP-20-016(V02) and P-SC-GP-20-017(V02) [received 13/12/2019]. Transport Responses [received 17/02/2020]. Cycle storage specification (Economy Shelter) [received 06/03/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the development a Construction Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include:
i.	a site plan
ii.	confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused
iii.	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv.	provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site
v.	details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi.	details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network
vii.	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
viii.	provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council
ix.	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
x.	appropriate vehicle routes to and from the site
xi.	measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access
xii.	commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts.
xiii.	avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the use a Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority for each building that is part of that phase. The Plan shall require details on vehicles would deliver to the site. The measures approved in the Plan shall be implemented and maintained permanently maintained.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 8pm Monday to Sunday.  Noisy works (defined as works which can be heard outside the boundary of the park) shall only take place between 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Sunday.
 
No vehicle movements shall take place outside of the hours 0800 to 2000 Monday - Sunday.

Condition : 6 - The cycle storage units referred to in the approved plans shall be installed and made available for use prior to the first event and the spaces shall be available throughout the duration of the event.

Condition : 7 - The floodlighting hereby approved shall only be operational 0800-23.30 and turned off at all other times, except for that required for security and safety purposes.  Floodlighting will take into consideration the location of and proximity to local residential premises.

Condition : 8 - The uses and structures hereby approved shall only be operational 18:00-23:30 for the duration of the permission (17:45-23:30 on Saturdays and Sundays), except for on Friday 24th July, when an additional show for school children will also be run from 12:00-16:00.

Condition : 9 - The applicant shall keep a photo record and site conditions report for the duration of the time limit specified in Condition 1, and on conclusion of the events hereby approved shall, within two months, complete the necessary remediation to return the site to its pre-event state as a minimum (save for any wear and tear as identified in the lease agreement).

Condition : 10 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the protocol outlined in the Noise Management Protocol, or such other protocol as agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, and shall be carried out in accordance with the details set out in the submitted Noise Management Plan and supporting information.

Condition : 11 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the events management documents pertaining to crowd management and staggered movements of guests contained within the Audience Dispersal Plan, Audience Arrangements (Safety), Transport Assessments and Indicative Audience Dispersal Plan.
